sources: Sources: official airport weather reports (10:00 PM) and airport forecasts (issued 7:00 PM) from aviationweather.gov for 9 airports. The other 27 airports have no official airport report, so they use the MET Norway location forecast (updated 9:16 PM) and are marked Estimate. Estimates show rain and wind only and cannot confirm thunderstorms, so an Estimate airport is never shown as Danger. For Estimates, bad weather means moderate or heavy rain (2.5 mm or more in an hour), or winds of 39 km/h or more. Tomorrow and days-ahead outlooks use the same airport forecasts and MET Norway estimates and are less certain than today's alerts. Typhoon watch is from aviation storm warnings (SIGMET) on aviationweather.gov, checked 10:28 PM; these look 6 hours ahead only. Earthquakes are from PHIVOLCS (magnitude 4.5 and stronger), data as of Oct 8, 10:28 PM. Accuracy ranking, highest first: 1) official airport report, 2) official airport forecast, 3) official aviation area warning, 4) computer forecast estimate. The moving rain layer on the map is a MET Norway forecast, rebuilt every few hours; it is a picture of the forecast and plays no part in the alert levels. When sources differ the higher-ranked one is used, and each airport's details show its confidence. If a source cannot be reached, its backup is used automatically and the Data sources table shows which one supplied the data. Times are Philippine time.
